criteria: This is the plan of a client slide deck, one object per slide. Every content slide's headline (the `headline` field, not the `eyebrow`) states a conclusion as a full sentence, such as 'Nobody in Boise owns emergency dental search yet', never a topic label such as 'Competitive Landscape' or 'Our Team'. Cover and section dividers are exempt.

The diagnosis slide's headline names a single problem the client has today, rather than listing several problems or describing an opportunity. (The stat count and line count are checked elsewhere; judge only the headline.)

The not-doing slide gives, for every item, the reason it is not being done as a full sentence, and names the event that would make it worth revisiting (a short phrase is fine for the trigger). It is not a bare list of service names.
Every content slide (all slides except the cover and the three section dividers) has speaker notes that say what to say, name one number or point to emphasise, and name the likely pushback.

assertions.pattern: (?m)^\| diagnosis\: two lines at most \| PASS \|
